عبد العظيم بن عبد الله الحسني
أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب

notes: Shurayh speaks in the chain's words, and the Imam Ali speaks inside Shurayh's story, so Ali is the last link (owner ruling 5).
أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب is copied as the report names him; the honorific is left out.
The Amali's own shaykh opens the chain (حدثنا), so the first name is the compiler's teacher, read as written.
